issues.code_location: CancunGasCalculator.BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOB field definition: private static final long BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOB = 1 << 16;
issues.description: The code defines BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOB as 1 << 16 (65536) while the specification requires 131072 (2**17 / 1<<17). The inline comment correctly states '1 << 17 = 131072 = 0x20000' but the code implements 1 << 16, exactly half the required value.
issues.potential_impact: Critical consensus failure: blobGasCost() undercharges blob gas by 2x. get_total_blob_gas, blob fee calculation, MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK (786432) and TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK (393216) accounting all break. Node would accept up to 12 blobs per block instead of 6, diverge from correct chain, and allow fee underpayment and potential DoS via excess blob data.
issues.suggestion: Change to private static final long BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOB = 1 << 17; (131072) to match GAS_PER_BLOB = 2**17.

summary: The CancunGasCalculator blob gas implementation deviates critically from EIP-4844: BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOB is 65536 instead of 131072. This halves all blob gas accounting and breaks consensus with the specification.
